name: Professor Onyx
description: A Strixhaven professor who tasked the twins with defending against the Oriq; in truth Liliana Vess.

description_citations.text: "Will Kenrith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx urges the twins to prepare for Extus.
timeline.quote: Professor Onyx urged the twins to prepare for the dark mage Extus

citation.text: Professor's Warning (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As a student Dina researches a forbidden resurrection spell and planar travel to find an Esis root to revive the glade.
timeline.quote: Dina wished to revive the glade and started to research a forbidden resurrection spell.

citation.text: "Dina", section "Student". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kasmina invites the twins to Strixhaven, where Rowan struggles and the twins quarrel until Professor Onyx stops them and tasks them with preparing a defense against the Oriq.
timeline.quote: The siblings were invited to join Strixhaven as students by Kasmina .

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rowan and Will face Extus Narr and the Blood Avatar beneath the Biblioplex and join powers so Will wrests control of the Avatar, which kills Extus but gravely wounds Will.
timeline.quote: The Avatar killed the Oriq leader and was sent back from where it came, but not before gravely wounding Will.

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kasmina invites the twins to Strixhaven; Professor Onyx tasks them with defending against an Oriq attack.
timeline.quote: The siblings were invited to join Strixhaven as students by Kasmina .

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan face Extus Narr and the Blood Avatar beneath the Biblioplex; Will gains control of the Avatar, which kills Extus Narr but severs Will's leg.
timeline.quote: The Avatar killed the Oriq leader and was sent back from where it came, but not before it hacked off Will's leg.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Onyx is translocated away and the Kenrith twins are kept at bay.
timeline.quote: the professor was translocated away while the twins were easily kept at bay

citation.text: "Extus Narr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
